spans.s:
(इ) मडि r. 1st cl. (मण्डते)
1 To divide, to separate.
2 To surround, to encompass.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (मण्डति मण्डयति)
To adorn, to grace, to decorate.
r. 10th cl. (मण्डयति)
To gladden, to rejoice, to make happy.

(ऋ) माडृ r. 1st cl. (माडति-ते)
To measure, to weigh.

m. (-डः)
Weight or quantity.
E.
माड to weigh, अच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A kind of grain, (Eleusine corocana.)

m. (-ड्डुः)
A sort of drum.
E.
मस्ज to purify, aff. उ, deriv. irr.; also with कन् added, मड्डुक.

m. (-कः)
A drummer, a player on the sort of drum called Maḍḍaka or Maḍḍu, q. v.
E.
मड्डुक as above, and अण् aff.; also with ठक् aff. माड्डुकिक.
